simplelan.configuration.title: SimpleLan
simplelan.configuration.enabled.tooltip:
Master switch. When false, SimpleLan never opens a world to LAN on its own, but the commands still work.
/simplelan for the current status
/simplelan republish [port] to reopen on another port
/simplelan defaults <port> to save the default port
simplelan.configuration.remind.tooltip:
Reminds the port number once more after this many
seconds, in case other mods bury the first hint in
chat spam. It reminds only once, it does not repeat.
0 disables the reminder, 1 or more is the delay.
simplelan.configuration.port.tooltip:
Port used when opening a world to LAN. 0 lets Minecraft pick a free port, anything else is used as-is.
Ports below 1024 need administrator rights and are often taken by system services.
Change now: /simplelan republish <port>
Save it: /simplelan defaults <port>
simplelan.chat.repeat: SimpleLan: local game is still hosted on port %s
simplelan.chat.publishFailed: SimpleLan: could not open port %s, it may already be in use or need administrator rights
simplelan.command.no_world: SimpleLan: load a singleplayer world first
simplelan.command.republish.same: SimpleLan: already open on port %s, pick a different one
simplelan.command.republish.failed: SimpleLan: could not open to LAN on port %s
simplelan.command.defaults.done: SimpleLan: default port set to %s, it applies the next time you load a world
simplelan.command.defaults.failed: SimpleLan: could not write the config file
